description: In every PA-model, the actual occurrence test finds no requested auxiliary constant in any internally constructed numeral.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.numeral_occursAux_zero.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA]
  (j n : M) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.occursAux.value
      ![j, Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.numeral.value ![n]] =
    Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M
